title: Quantifying and Mitigating Selection Bias in LLMs: A Transferable LoRA Fine-Tuning and Efficient Majority Voting Approach
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical selection biases (such as answer position or option symbols) in Large Language Models when answering multiple-choice questions. Its evaluations are performed on benchmarks related to general science, medical knowledge, and telecommunications, and do not involve religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
